contexts.text: Could you recommend a hotel? I have not decided where, who will join, or who will pay.
这次可能公司付款，也可能我自己付，现在还不能确定。
这次 not driving，也不需要 parking。
I am travelling alone to Tokyo and paying for the trip myself.
Dinner with friends in Seattle; the meal must contain no peanuts.
还没决定去徒步还是普通观光，两种都有可能。
请安排住宿，destination 尚未确定，同行人也没定。
It is a business trip, but I am paying personally.
We might depart Tuesday evening or Wednesday evening; both remain possible.
去机场接同事，需要一辆七座车。
I need help with breakfast ideas.
之前说公司付，其实已经改成我自己付。

memories.text: No matter where I travel, I prefer accommodation near public transport.
我喜欢早餐丰富的酒店。
When my employer pays, I can choose a more expensive hotel.
For meetings on Tuesday or Wednesday evening, prepare the materials early.
我曾经在上海吃过一家餐厅。
Regardless of who joins the trip，我都优先选择直达交通。
When driving to hiking areas, parking is required.
热闹区域也可以，只要房间隔音好。
When buying electronics, I prefer durable products.
不要把会议安排在晚上九点以后。
